title: Surface Characterization on Agricultural Grade Steel with Boriding Treatment
content: Plow tools tend to deteriorate; this is due to the constant contact with different types of dry and wet tillage fields, as well as soil-tool friction and erosion by chemical fertilizers on the tools [1-2-3]; With these situations that present these components, it is given to the task of developing a surface coating using dehydrated boron paste for the possibility of improving the useful life of the tool life in the agricultural field [4-5].
